goals_five_year_root_check.name: goals_five_year_root_check
goals_five_year_root_check.value: "goals"."level" <> 'five_year' or ("goals"."parent_id" is null and "goals"."category" is not null)

goals_currency_check.name: goals_currency_check
goals_currency_check.value: ("goals"."unit" = 'currency') = ("goals"."currency" is not null) and ("goals"."currency" is null or "goals"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

goals_key_result_shape_check.name: goals_key_result_shape_check
goals_key_result_shape_check.value: not "goals"."is_key_result" or ("goals"."parent_id" is not null and "goals"."measurement_mode" <> 'key_results')

tasks_minutes_check.name: tasks_minutes_check
tasks_minutes_check.value: ("tasks"."estimated_minutes" is null or "tasks"."estimated_minutes" between 0 and 10000) and ("tasks"."actual_minutes" is null or "tasks"."actual_minutes" between 0 and 10000)

tasks_mit_check.name: tasks_mit_check
tasks_mit_check.value: ("tasks"."mit_on" is null) = ("tasks"."mit_rank" is null) and ("tasks"."mit_rank" is null or "tasks"."mit_rank" between 1 and 3)

tasks_finish_after_start_check.name: tasks_finish_after_start_check
tasks_finish_after_start_check.value: "tasks"."finished_at" is null or "tasks"."started_at" is null or "tasks"."finished_at" >= "tasks"."started_at"

roadmap_quarters_review_dates_check.name: roadmap_quarters_review_dates_check
roadmap_quarters_review_dates_check.value: ("roadmap_quarters"."mid_review_on" is null or "roadmap_quarters"."mid_review_on" between "roadmap_quarters"."start_date" and "roadmap_quarters"."end_date") and ("roadmap_quarters"."review_on" is null or "roadmap_quarters"."review_on" >= "roadmap_quarters"."start_date")

habits_weekly_target_check.name: habits_weekly_target_check
habits_weekly_target_check.value: ("habits"."schedule_kind" = 'weekly') = ("habits"."weekly_target" is not null) and ("habits"."weekly_target" is null or "habits"."weekly_target" between 1 and 7)

sales_activities_amount_check.name: sales_activities_amount_check
sales_activities_amount_check.value: ("sales_activities"."amount" is null) = ("sales_activities"."currency" is null) and ("sales_activities"."amount" is null or ("sales_activities"."kind" = 'quotation' and "sales_activities"."amount" >= 0))

comm_sessions_target_check.name: comm_sessions_target_check
comm_sessions_target_check.value: "comm_practice_sessions"."skill_id" is not null or "comm_practice_sessions"."exercise_id" is not null

product_features_scores_check.name: product_features_scores_check
product_features_scores_check.value: ("product_features"."impact" is null or "product_features"."impact" between 1 and 5) and ("product_features"."effort" is null or "product_features"."effort" between 1 and 5)

products_launched_check.name: products_launched_check
products_launched_check.value: "products"."stage" not in ('launch', 'growth', 'optimization') or "products"."launched_on" is not null

product_validation_evidence_value_check.name: product_validation_evidence_value_check
product_validation_evidence_value_check.value: "product_validation_evidence"."kind" not in ('metric', 'visitors', 'signups', 'payment') or "product_validation_evidence"."value" is not null

content_items_platform_format_check.name: content_items_platform_format_check
content_items_platform_format_check.value: ("content_items"."platform" is null and "content_items"."format" is null) or ((platform = 'instagram' and format in ('reel', 'carousel', 'post', 'story', 'live')) or (platform = 'youtube' and format in ('long_video', 'short', 'live')) or (platform = 'linkedin' and format in ('text_post', 'document', 'video', 'article', 'newsletter')))

content_metrics_nonnegative_check.name: content_metrics_nonnegative_check
content_metrics_nonnegative_check.value:
coalesce("content_metrics"."views", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("content_metrics"."reach", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("content_metrics"."impressions", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("content_metrics"."likes", 0) >= 0
        and coalesce("content_metrics"."comments", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("content_metrics"."shares", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("content_metrics"."saves", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("content_metrics"."watch_time_minutes", 0) >= 0
        and coalesce("content_metrics"."avg_view_seconds", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("content_metrics"."profile_visits", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("content_metrics"."website_clicks", 0) >= 0
        and coalesce("content_metrics"."leads", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("content_metrics"."sales_count", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("content_metrics"."sales_amount", 0) >= 0

content_metrics_pct_check.name: content_metrics_pct_check
content_metrics_pct_check.value: ("content_metrics"."avg_retention_pct" is null or "content_metrics"."avg_retention_pct" between 0 and 100) and ("content_metrics"."completion_rate_pct" is null or "content_metrics"."completion_rate_pct" between 0 and 100)

knowledge_resources_dates_check.name: knowledge_resources_dates_check
knowledge_resources_dates_check.value: "knowledge_resources"."completed_on" is null or "knowledge_resources"."started_on" is null or "knowledge_resources"."completed_on" >= "knowledge_resources"."started_on"

knowledge_resources_units_check.name: knowledge_resources_units_check
knowledge_resources_units_check.value: ("knowledge_resources"."total_units" is null or "knowledge_resources"."total_units" > 0) and ("knowledge_resources"."progress_units" is null or "knowledge_resources"."progress_units" >= 0) and ("knowledge_resources"."total_units" is null or "knowledge_resources"."progress_units" is null or "knowledge_resources"."progress_units" <= "knowledge_resources"."total_units")

reading_goals_values_check.name: reading_goals_values_check
reading_goals_values_check.value: ("reading_goals"."target_count" is null or "reading_goals"."target_count" between 1 and 1000) and ("reading_goals"."daily_minutes" is null or "reading_goals"."daily_minutes" between 1 and 1440)
